title: video
description:
Ultra-realistic cinematic video, 10 seconds, divided into 3 continuous shots in the EXACT SAME LOCATION.
A cozy traditional ahwa (Egyptian café) in Downtown Cairo (وسط البلد) during the evening. Wooden chairs, marble tables, old buildings, warm street lights, passing cars, people chatting, waiters carrying tea and coffee, authentic Egyptian atmosphere. The location never changes.
Two characters remain identical throughout the video:
Character 1: A 40-year-old Egyptian man, around 80 kg, olive skin, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a black t-shirt, blue jeans, and sneakers.
Character 2: A realistic but funny-looking alien with expressive eyes, light green skin, proportional body, wearing a white t-shirt with a colorful UFO/alien graphic, casual jeans, and sneakers. The alien is believable and cinematic, not cartoonish, with a deep masculine voice.
They are sitting at the same table playing backgammon (طاولة). Throughout the video they naturally move the pieces, throw the dice, smile, react, and maintain eye contact while talking.
Shot 1 (0–3.5s)
Medium close-up of ONLY the Egyptian man.
The alien is completely outside the frame to create curiosity.
The man throws the dice, moves a backgammon piece, briefly looks toward someone sitting opposite him (off camera), smiles naturally and says in Egyptian Arabic:
"يعني إنت جايلي مخصوص عشان تتعلم ذكاء اصطناعي؟"
Natural pause after speaking while continuing the game.
Shot 2 (3.5–6.5s)
Medium close-up of ONLY the alien.
The Egyptian man is now off camera.
The alien calmly rolls the dice, moves one backgammon piece while looking at the man and replies with a deep masculine voice in Egyptian Arabic:
"هو إنت مش مصدقني ليه يا برو؟"
He gives a small amused smile and shrugs naturally.
Shot 3 (6.5–10s)
Medium two-shot showing both characters together at the same table.
They continue playing naturally.
The alien focuses on the board while moving another piece.
The Egyptian man laughs genuinely and says:
"العب... العب."
Both continue playing normally as people walk behind them and café life continues naturally.
Style & Realism Requirements
Hyper-realistic
Documentary-style realism
Egyptian cinematic atmosphere
Warm evening lighting
Natural handheld camera
Slight camera shake
Authentic Downtown Cairo ambience
Real café sounds
Cars passing
People talking in the background
Tea glasses
Dice rolling sounds
Backgammon pieces clicking
Natural pauses in conversation
Human timing
Genuine laughter
Visible skin texture and pores
No beauty filters
No plastic skin
Real facial imperfections
Natural blinking
Micro facial expressions
Accurate Arabic lip sync
Consistent voices
Consistent clothing
Consistent alien appearance
Maintain identical characters, clothing, voices, table, backgammon board, and café throughout all shots. No face changes, no clothing changes, no scene changes, no age changes, no character redesign between shots. The alien must remain realistic with subtle comedic charm, never cartoonish or animated.
